notes.title: Update 1.0.5 - Release notes
notes.content:
Finally found the time to push the new update! 

This is mostly a maintenance and stability update, with a lot of performance improvements, UI polish, added control features, and Steam cloud saves!

Here's the full list:

- Input improvements and more controllers supported

- Improved Controller mapper screen

- Performance and compatibility improvements

- Screen refresh rate options added

- Retina screen Mac improvements

- Steam Cloud saves

- Graphics and UI improvements

Please get in touch if you have feedback or any issue with the new version, and thanks again for playing Oath!

tags.feature: - Input improvements and more controllers supported

notes.title: v.1.0.4 now available!
notes.content:
Hi there,

I've just uploaded another update for Oath. Here are the release notes:

- Bosses difficulty balancing

- Level design balancing

- Improved third-party controllers support

- Improved Retina Screens support on Mac

- Fixed bug where the level background would disappear on certain instances

- Performance improvements


Feel free to get in touch if you have any issues with the update.

Hope you'll enjoy play the game, more updates and improvements are coming soon!

tags.feature: - Improved Retina Screens support on Mac

tags.bug: - Fixed bug where the level background would disappear on certain instances

notes.title: Game Post-mortem and v1.0.3
notes.content:
I've recently published a Post-mortem of the game on Gamasutra, you can find it here: https://www.gamasutra.com/blogs/AttilioCarotenuto/20170927/306590/Postmortem_of_my_first_Indie_Game.php

Also, v.1.0.3 is now available with some minor changes and improvements:

- Added French and German language support

- Increased gamepad models support

- Tweaked and increased laser power 

- Changed Player 2 name to avoid confusion

- Fixed resolution issue on Linux


I'm currently working on a major update with new content and improved balancing, please follow this page to stay updated!

tags.bug: - Changed Player 2 name to avoid confusion
